Stock starts at available=reserved=0; each field ranges from zero to five. Quantity is one to three. Unauthorized requests reject with 200. Reserve (150) above available rejects 201; Release (151) or Ship (152) above reserved rejects 202. Reject capacity overflow with 203. Otherwise Reserve transfers available to reserved, Release reverses that transfer, Ship removes reserved units and sends their quantity to warehouse on channel 300, and Restock (153) adds available units.
